We are delighted that you are interested in joining our Biomedical Science Graduate
Program. At ETSU, we strive to keep our application process straightforward and simple.
Below, you'll find information about admissions requirements and frequently asked
questions.
Requirements
Transcripts
Unofficial transcripts may be submitted with your application. Official transcripts
will be required upon acceptance to a Graduate program.
Recommendations
3 recommendations to be submitted through the online application. Letters of recommendation
should be from individuals who are able to describe your research abilities and/or
academic preparedness for graduate school.
Curriculum Vitae
Test Scores
The GRE score is not required.
Personal Statement
Please include the following in your personal statement (maximum 1000 words):
Prior research experience(s)-describe research conducted and your role on the project
Research interests at ETSU
Career goals
Additional Requirements
May require an interview
Apply Today!
Our program is ready to prepare you for all that you need to succeed! Prospective
students may easily submit their application materials through ETSU's online application
portal.
General Admissions Requirements
The GRE score is not required for application to the Biomedical Science Graduate Program.
View step by step application instructions.
Frequently Asked Questions:
How do I submit an application?
Application to our program is made online through the ETSU Graduate School. To submit
an application please view the instructions for the Biomedical Sciences-Ph.D. application
on the Graduate School Doctoral Degrees web page. For general application instructions/information please see the Graduate School Application Instructions web page.
What is the deadline for submitting an application?
Please view the application deadlines for the Biomedical Sciences-Ph.D. application
on the Graduate School Doctoral Degrees web page. Most of the positions for Fall admission will be filled early in the Spring semester.
We advise all students who are considering applying to our program to complete their
applications as early as possible.
For what semester of entry are applications accepted?
Under most circumstances, students are admitted only for the Fall semester.
How do I inquire about the status of my application?
Please contact the Graduate School at gradadmissions@etsu.edu or 423-439-4221 regarding the receipt and processing of application materials. Feel free to contact
Dr. Amy Gravitte at berryag@etsu.edu or 423-439-2031 for any questions you have about the program.
Is a formal interview required?
Well qualified applicants who reside in the United States will usually be invited
to visit us.  During the visit, applicants have an opportunity to tour the research
facilities and to meet with students and faculty.  Applicants will also meet with
one or two members of the admissions committee.  Applicants may wish to contact faculty
to inquire about the possibility of working with them.  This can be helpful in determining
potential faculty advisors.
Who do I contact for information about the M.S. in Biology program?
If you are interested in the M.S. in Biology (Biomedical Sciences concentration), please contact Dr. Gerardo Arceo-Gomez (gomezg@etsu.edu) in the Department of Biological Sciences in the Phil and Martha Bachman College
of Arts and Sciences.
Where do I find campus maps, directions, and parking information?
Please see our campus maps web page for building location and parking information.
How do I apply for financial aid?
All applicants are considered for financial support. Most students who are admitted
to the program will be offered support through a research assistantship that includes
a competitive stipend and payment of tuition and fees.
Questions?
Feel free to contact our office (e-mail berryag@etsu.edu or call 423-439-2031) for any questions you have about the program.
